why: A man appears out of the darkness about thirty yards from the stables. 'Stranger' is a fair paraphrase and reveals no identity.
The story says he carried a heavy stick with a knob to it.
His grey tweed suit, cloth cap and gaiters are described in this paragraph.
On Monday night, after nine, the man called on Edith Baxter to stop as she neared the stables.
The man is unidentified, so a reader would naturally ask who he was. The wording points at no answer.
